items.title: Cedar Walton — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: play, uh, uh, with uh, Gene Ammons and Sonny Stitt.

ctx.x: Yeah. And from the musicians' standpoint, you know, all that food at every table, and uh … [chuckles] Well, you were sittin' down. You've sat down and ate with me; you know I'm a, I'm a, shall we say uh, uh moderate, I practice moderate intake. I saved part of my sandwich. It's right over there in the, on ice, so …. But anyway, in those days though I wasn't nearly as moderate. I would eat some from every one of those tables. And there was a fun, one fun thing was to, to play, which I did at least once, uh, play,…
them to compete upon stage. But that was, uh, Sonny's, uh, uh, uh mode of … What do you call it? I can say it in French. Mode … uh [laughs].
